related.title: GNU Guix與Mes：引導種子與工具鏈信任閉包
related.titleEn: GNU Guix and Mes: bootstrap seeds and toolchain trust closure
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算，剩餘2個缺口明列；快取命中率沒有被誤當安全率。 交付bazel-action-closure.csv、同key不同輸出負例與讀寫者矩陣；不連接真實遠端快取。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 75 and 90 percent, list the two remaining gaps and keep cache-hit rate separate from security assurance. Deliver bazel-action-closure.csv, same-key/different-output counterexamples and the reader/writer matrix without connecting to a real remote cache.
related.difference: 建立12個簡化工具鏈節點，列每個節點的來源、建置前驅、二進位種子與驗證方式；以有向無環圖找出所有無來源重建路徑的葉節點。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 simplified toolchain nodes with source, build predecessor, binary seed and verification method. Traverse the directed acyclic graph to identify leaves lacking a source reconstruction path instead of judging only the final compiler artifact.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課封閉性覆蓋率為已完整列出影響輸入的動作比例；只有覆蓋完整仍不足以證明寫入者可信，快取ACL與產物完整性另列關卡。 20個動作中15個輸入契約完整，5個缺少時區、工具版本或工作目錄依賴；每個缺口列出可重現的反例變數。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；修正其中3個動作後為18/20×100=90%，剩下2個仍不能宣稱封閉。
本課計算仍依賴未審查種子的節點數，去重後取相依閉包；節點數不是位元組大小或風險機率，歷史Guix種子縮減數字不混入合成資料。 12個節點中有5個依賴未審查種子，其他7個在本課已審查閉包內；固定平台為教學模型，不宣稱對所有CPU架構適用。 未審查相依比例5/12×100≈41.667%；重建並審查一條種子路徑，使其中2個節點脫離未審查集合後為3/12×100=25%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Define closure coverage as the fraction of actions whose influential inputs are fully declared. Complete closure alone does not authenticate a cache writer; write authorization and artifact integrity remain separate gates in the cache trust model. Fifteen of 20 actions have complete input contracts. Five omit timezone, tool version or working-directory dependencies, with a reproducible counterexample variable recorded for each omission rather than an unexplained nonhermetic label. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Repairing three actions gives 18/20×100=90 percent; the remaining two still prevent a claim of complete declared-input closure.

Count nodes still depending on an unreviewed seed after deduplicating the dependency closure. Node count is neither byte size nor compromise probability; do not mix historical Guix reduction figures into this synthetic graph. Five of 12 nodes depend on an unreviewed seed and seven lie within the reviewed classroom closure. Fix the teaching platform and avoid implying that identical bootstrap paths apply to every CPU architecture or operating system. Unreviewed dependency fraction is 5/12×100, approximately 41.667 percent. Rebuilding and reviewing one seed path removes two nodes from that set, leaving 3/12×100=25 percent.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Elastic ECS：三種時間戳與延遲責任分解
related.titleEn: Elastic ECS: three timestamps and latency ownership
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：75%與90%可重算，剩餘2個缺口明列；快取命中率沒有被誤當安全率。 交付bazel-action-closure.csv、同key不同輸出負例與讀寫者矩陣；不連接真實遠端快取。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce 75 and 90 percent, list the two remaining gaps and keep cache-hit rate separate from security assurance. Deliver bazel-action-closure.csv, same-key/different-output counterexamples and the reader/writer matrix without connecting to a real remote cache.
related.difference: 保留原始時間字串、時區、事件ID與三種時間欄位，拒絕把攝取時間覆寫為事件發生時間。
related.differenceEn: Preserve raw strings, timezone, event ID and all three timestamps; reject overwriting occurrence time with ingestion time.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課封閉性覆蓋率為已完整列出影響輸入的動作比例；只有覆蓋完整仍不足以證明寫入者可信，快取ACL與產物完整性另列關卡。 20個動作中15個輸入契約完整，5個缺少時區、工具版本或工作目錄依賴；每個缺口列出可重現的反例變數。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；修正其中3個動作後為18/20×100=90%，剩下2個仍不能宣稱封閉。
總延遲是代理前等待加代理後傳送；只有時鐘已對齊時，各差值才能作為非負管線延遲。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 同一合成事件以秒為單位：發生100、讀取103、攝取111；所有時鐘共用已明示的時間基準。 前段延遲3秒、後段8秒、總延遲11秒；三段差值必須閉合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Define closure coverage as the fraction of actions whose influential inputs are fully declared. Complete closure alone does not authenticate a cache writer; write authorization and artifact integrity remain separate gates in the cache trust model. Fifteen of 20 actions have complete input contracts. Five omit timezone, tool version or working-directory dependencies, with a reproducible counterexample variable recorded for each omission rather than an unexplained nonhermetic label. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Repairing three actions gives 18/20×100=90 percent; the remaining two still prevent a claim of complete declared-input closure.

Total delay splits into pre-agent and post-agent terms; interpreting them as nonnegative latency requires aligned clocks. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic event occurs at second 100, is read at 103 and ingested at 111, using one stated time reference. Pre-agent latency is 3 seconds, downstream latency 8 seconds and end-to-end latency 11 seconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
